notes: Only warmup sampling and tracking error scales differ between groups.
Network [128,128], learning_starts=2000, gamma, residual limits, regularization weights and entropy mechanism are held fixed from base_config.
Tracking tolerance scales are experimental starting values, not validated engineering requirements.
Checkpoint selection minimizes mean cross-track RMSE subject to physical guards; training return is not used across reward modes.
A model needs at least 0.1 mm mean cross-track improvement over zero residual with success rate maintained, yaw/turn/rate within 5%, final distance within +5 mm, duration within +0.5 s.
Screening and reserved_final use different route-variation seeds within the same three path families; this does not establish generalization to new path families.
reserved_final is not executed by the training or default screening command.
